dataSetInformation.common:generalComment:
This process was created based on the following process: "Hot rolling, steel {CH}". The material input for the loss consists of 100% secondary material. The ‘sheet rolling, electric’ process with secondary material was used to have only secondary material flows in the upstream process chain.
To achieve greater toughness, shock resistance and tensile strength, the raw steel production outputs cast ingots, slabs, billets and beam blanks are hot rolled to long or flat products or semifinished products.
Synonyms: Hot forming UUID: dd238527-e7bd-45ee-881d-b9a858f7fb3c
